title: CSP follow-ups to #1917: the shipped launcher path is tested, form-action is set, the default report-only header no longer flags the shipped bootstrap, and non-SPA HTML carries an enforced script-src

criteria.then: a live spec loads /ui/ and a deep link from the launcher (meta policy, SpaFallbackFilter) and fails on enforced violations only (securitypolicyviolation disposition 'enforce')
the SPA policy carries form-action 'self' (it does not fall back to default-src)
it ships no default Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only policy (the shell's enforced meta policy replaces it, so the SvelteKit bootstrap is no longer reported on every page load)
responses outside the SPA shell (/ui/**) and the hash-pinned demo pages get an enforced script-src 'self' header by default
a release note covers the build-time policy and how to handle http: image tiles and CDN fonts
